Maximum.description: The MTConnect constraints. The Values or the Minimum, Maximum, and Nominal       values should be provided. Multiple Values can be provided as an array as       a set of allowable values for this \gls{MTDataItem}. A constraint is used       by a software application to evaluate the validity of the reported data.
